Keep these explicitly separate from host validation HR@10; use one frozen NextItNet checkpoint per category and no additional fitted predictor.

searches.reason: Translate qualitative feedback into auditable recommendation-level evidence: specific recent connection, apparent duplication, stated fit requirements, and insufficient information. Seek annotation protocols with explicit abstention, agreement checks, and uncertainty for the twenty training users. Use only histories, timestamps, titles, and descriptions; distinguish textual evidence from unobserved intent, ownership, compatibility, or satisfaction.

searches.reason: Move beyond input sensitivity toward locating which jointly trained convolutional blocks carry useful recent-history information. Investigate matched-history activation patching and controlled order perturbations, calibrated with no-op, padding, and synthetic known-dependency controls. Preserve the original final nonpadding readout and test whether findings survive frequency and history-length controls; require no extra trained models.
